original_query: select     s_store_name   ,s_company_id   ,s_street_number   ,s_street_name   ,s_street_type   ,s_suite_number   ,s_city   ,s_county   ,s_state   ,s_zip   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30 ) then 1 else 0 end)  as "30 days"   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30) and                  (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) then 1 else 0 end )  as "31-60 days"   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60) and                  (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) then 1 else 0 end)  as "61-90 days"   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90) and                  (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) then 1 else 0 end)  as "91-120 days"   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk  > 120) then 1 else 0 end)  as ">120 days" from    store_sales   ,store_returns   ,store   ,date_dim d1   ,date_dim d2 where     d2.d_year = 2000 and d2.d_moy  = 4 and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk   = d1.d_date_sk and sr_returned_date_sk   = d2.d_date_sk and ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk and d1.d_date between (d2.d_date - interval '120' day)                and d2.d_date group by    s_store_name   ,s_company_id   ,s_street_number   ,s_street_name   ,s_street_type   ,s_suite_number   ,s_city   ,s_county   ,s_state   ,s_zip order by s_store_name         ,s_company_id         ,s_street_number         ,s_street_name         ,s_street_type         ,s_suite_number         ,s_city         ,s_county         ,s_state         ,s_zip limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        d2.d_date AS return_date
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_date >= DATE '2000-04-01'
      AND d2.d_date <  DATE '2000-05-01'
),
return_days AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS days_between
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_returns sr
      ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
     AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_date >= sr.return_date - INTERVAL '120 days'
      AND d1.d_date <= sr.return_date
      AND d1.d_date >= DATE '1999-12-03'
      AND d1.d_date <= DATE '2000-04-30'
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss_store_sk,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE days_between <= 30) AS "30 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE days_between > 30 AND days_between <= 60) AS "31-60 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE days_between > 60 AND days_between <= 90) AS "61-90 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE days_between > 90 AND days_between <= 120) AS "91-120 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE days_between > 120) AS ">120 days"
    FROM return_days
    GROUP BY ss_store_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip,
    a."30 days",
    a."31-60 days",
    a."61-90 days",
    a."91-120 days",
    a.">120 days"
FROM store_agg a
JOIN store s
  ON a.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
ORDER BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace implicit comma-style joins with explicit ANSI JOIN syntax, improving readability and join-condition maintainability (rewrite score 6/10).
Rewrite d2.d_year=2000 AND d2.d_moy=4 into a range predicate d2.d_date >= '2000-04-01' AND d2.d_date < '2000-05-01', which is sargable and can use an index on d_date (rewrite score 5/10).

Defer the small store dimension join until after aggregation: aggregate by ss_store_sk first (single integer key, only ~102 stores) then join store and sort. This enables HashAggregate and avoids sorting/aggregating over wide 10-column group keys (rewrite score 9/10, the largest win).
Compute sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk once as days_between in a CTE, eliminating repeated arithmetic in the five CASE expressions (rewrite score 3/10).
Replace SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ...), which is more readable and slightly cheaper (rewrite score 4/10).

Add the implied global sold-date range d1.d_date BETWEEN '1999-12-03' AND '2000-04-30' (April 2000 returns minus 120 days) so the planner may use a d1 date range / join order starting from the filtered date range (rewrite score 4/10).
